title: One review thread, as `show --json` prints it
description: The thread shape shared by review-md (comments on Markdown notes) and development-manager's page comments (comments on web pages). Each tool keeps its own storage; this is what both hand out. This file is the source; page comments keep a pinned copy. Readers must ignore fields, anchor types and statuses they don't know. See docs/agent-contract.md.

resolved.description: true when the thread is closed. A reader that doesn't know `status` reads a dismissed thread as resolved.

status.description: Optional. Page comments always set it; review-md threads leave it out, which means open or resolved as `resolved` says.

anchor.description: Where the thread points. The fields that apply depend on `type`.

type.description: Known types. review-md: text, header, link (quote), mermaidNode (node), mermaidEdge (from, to), image (src). Page comments: element and text (css, tag, label, quote as an object, box). Readers skip types they don't know.

quote.description: The anchored words. review-md stores the passage as a string; page comments store {exact, prefix, suffix}, with up to 32 characters either side.

line.description: review-md: the line the passage was on

index.description: review-md: which copy of a repeated passage

blockId.description: review-md: a native Obsidian ^id on the source block

src.description: review-md image: path in the vault, or a web address

commentId.description: page comments: a data-comment-id the page put on the element

css.description: page comments: a CSS path to the element

label.description: page comments: the element's short label

box.description: page comments: where in the element the pin sits, as fractions of its width and height

rev.description: The version the thread was made against. review-md: bodyHash is the note body's hash; page comments: the element's hash.

anchorHash.description: review-md: hash of the anchored passage alone

dirty.description: page comments: made on uncommitted work

landed.description: page comments: the commit that later landed the uncommitted work the comment was made on. rev.git still says where it was made.

messages.description: In order; the first is the opening comment.

outdated.description: review-md --json: the note changed since the thread was made

lost.description: true when the anchored passage or element can't be found any more; left out when found

page.description: page comments: the page the thread is on

viewport.description: page comments: the window the comment was made in

waiting.description: page comments: who the thread is waiting on

shots.description: page comments: pictures of the element. Each has exactly one of icloud, local or error.

role.description: comment: taken when the comment was made; after: Claude's shot after a fix

icloud.description: path relative to the iCloud Drive root

local.description: path relative to the repo's .page-comments/ folder

sha.description: first 12 hex characters of the picture's sha256

commit.description: after shots: the commit the shot was taken against

error.description: why the capture failed, in place of a pointer

path.description: show --json only: the full path of the picture on this machine
